QuantRule quant roles
=====================
Normative: AGENTS.md section 10

Quant Researcher
  Manual: docs/roles/2026-10-29/quant-researcher-manual.md
  Owns: hypothesis, protocol, metrics, split, costs, pass/fail.
  Hands to: Quant Developer.

Quant Developer
  Manual: docs/roles/2026-10-29/quant-developer-manual.md
  Owns: implementation, tests, determinism, reproducible run.
  Hands to: Quant Validator.

Quant Validator
  Manual: docs/roles/2026-10-29/quant-validator-manual.md
  Owns: independent reproduction, bias and cost audit, verdict.
  Hands to: Human.

Handoff: researcher -> developer -> validator -> human.
A validator verdict is evidence, not approval.

Paths are relative to the repository root.
